emergency.safetyLine: If anyone is in danger, or you smell gas or see fire, hang up and call 911 now.

safetyLines.active_leak: If you can do so safely, shut off the nearest water valve while we contact the technician.
safetyLines.no_heat: Please avoid unsafe heating sources such as ovens or outdoor heaters indoors.
safetyLines.lockout: Please wait in a safe, well-lit place while we contact the technician.
safetyLines.no_power: If you see sparks or smell smoke, call 911 immediately.
